meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list into caveman format to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup. Trigger: /caveman-compress.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩长备忘为简短格式,节省 AI 输入,保留可读备份。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有一大摞项目备忘要交给 AI,却担心它占太多对话空间。
copy.tagline_en: Compress long notes into short text to save AI context; keep a readable backup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you feed AI very long notes and worry about hitting context limits.

howto.what: 装好后，把 CLAUDE.md、待办清单等记忆文件压缩成简短原始人风格，节省输入 token。压缩版覆盖原文件，可读备份存到系统数据目录的 backups 文件夹，不在原文件旁。
howto.when: 当你说 “/caveman-compress <文件路径>” 或要求压缩某个记忆文件（如 CLAUDE.md、待办列表）时触发。

say.note: 脚本启动，压缩并备份原文件

say.text: 帮我把 todo.txt 压缩成简短风格
say.note: 此文件会被覆盖，原文件存到备份目录

say.text: 压缩 PROJECT_NOTES.md，保留代码不动
say.note: 只压缩正文，代码块原样保留

howto.what_en: When installed, compresses memory files such as CLAUDE.md or todo lists into terse caveman style to save input tokens. The compressed version overwrites the original; a readable backup is stored in the system data directory's backups folder, not beside the source file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type "/caveman-compress <filepath>" or ask to compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list.

say_en.note: Starts the script, compresses and backs up
Only prose is compressed; code blocks preserved
